M1_numerical_accuracy.applicability_rule: Eligible only when ground_truth.value is a finite numeric scalar or a non-empty list/mapping whose every leaf is a finite numeric scalar. Booleans, text, mixed categorical/numeric structures, nulls, empty structures, clarification_required outcomes, and unsupported outcomes are not M1 targets.
